Sam (Release): Quick: final relnotes for today's docs roll. Need 3 bullets + one-line known issue. Keep it tiny for marketing.
Ivy (Docs): Draft lead: "Smaller failovers, lower inference cost, and clearer SDK migration guides."
Ken (SDK): Snippet change: replace `client.embed()` examples with `client.embeddings.generate(...)`. Example to paste: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.embeddings.generate(model="embed-small-v1", input="hello")
print(resp.vector[:8])
```
Alex (Eng): Note for known issue: quantized embeddings can alter magnitudes; runtime >=2026-04-01 has mitigation. One-liner: "Known issue: quantized embedding variants may change vector magnitudes; re-evaluate NN thresholds."
Ivy (Docs): Proposed bullets:
- Automatic fallback to compatible model variants (reduces downtime)
- Redwood Optimize: quantization suggestion panel and batch hints
- Docs: unified v2 SDK snippets and embedding API rename
Known issue: Quantized embedding variants may change vector magnitudes; re-evaluate nearest-neighbor thresholds after upgrading.
Sam (Release): Good. @deploy-bot queue staging deploy after snippet PR merges.
deploy-bot: staging deploy queued for 19:30 PT. Will post status here when complete.
Ivy (Docs): I'll open the changelog PR and merge after staging smoke passes. Thanks all! :raised_hands:
